title: confdelta: statistically rigorous comparison of two protein conformational ensembles
description: confdelta compares two protein conformational ensembles and reports, per residue, what changed, by how much, and whether it is real: effect sizes with confidence intervals first, multiple-testing-corrected q-values second. It chooses a replicate-level permutation test when replicates are supplied and a block bootstrap over autocorrelated frames otherwise, and is explicit about when a design is too small to conclude anything.
